title: [YSQL] Webserver appears to die unremarked, leading to loss of metrics being reported
body:
Noted in a K8s-based universe on GKE. The webserver for YSQL starts on pod instantiation but exits at some point without a trace. This leads to a loss of metrics for YSQL as well as statements. 

Noted in the postgres log at last tserver pod instantiation:

